HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   D. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)

   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.
   D. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)

   C. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items
